title: SH-WRNN: Implicit Spherical Harmonics Weight Field Routing Neural Networks for Asymmetric Edge Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.14614v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning architectures remain rigidly built upon traditional fully connected layers. While networks scale up, few challenge this foundational root. In this work, we reshape this paradigm by transforming the core synapse weight matrix from static, discrete parameters into a differentiable, continuous field governed by spherical harmonics functions. We introduce the Implicit Spherical Harmonics Weight Field Routing Neural Network (SH-WRNN), which constrains weight matrices within a continuous parametric field instead of optimizing millions of localized discrete weights. When retrieving the weight matrix of the current layer, connection parameters are localized using latitude and longitude on a rectangular plane mapped from the continuous field. translated_title: SH-WRNN：面向非对称边缘智能的隐式球谐权重场路由神经网络
translated_abstract: 深度学习架构至今仍僵化地构建在传统全连接层之上。尽管网络规模不断扩大，却很少有人挑战这一根本基础。在这项工作中，我们通过将核心突触权重矩阵从静态、离散的参数转变为由球谐函数支配的可微、连续场，重塑了这一范式。我们提出了隐式球谐权重场路由神经网络（SH-WRNN），它将权重矩阵约束在一个连续的参数场中，而无需优化数百万个局部的离散权重。在检索当前层的权重矩阵时，连接参数通过从连续场映射出的矩形平面上的经纬度进行定位。纬度坐标由前一层被激活的神经元指定，而经度坐标则由前一层激活经矩阵变换生成的键来确定。
tldr: 该论文提出SH-WRNN，将传统神经网络中静态离散的权重矩阵转化为由球谐函数参数化的连续可微权重场，通过前一层激活神经元的经纬度坐标路由机制动态检索权重，为非对称边缘智能提供了全新的网络架构范式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SH-WRNN, which transforms static discrete weight matrices into a continuous differentiable weight field parameterized by spherical harmonics, dynamically retrieving weights via a latitude-longitude coordinate routing mechanism driven by previous-layer activations, offering a novel architecture paradigm for asymmetric edge intelligence.
